bugs-bunny.start: What's up, doc? Looks like we're in for a good one.
bugs-bunny.reroute: I knew I shoulda taken that turn at Albuquerque!

cookie-monster.start: Om nom nom! Okay. Me drive now!
cookie-monster.arrive: We arrived! Now me get cookie! Om nom nom!

daffy-duck.start: Hoo hoo! Woo hoo! Road trip!
daffy-duck.reroute: Rerouting! It's fine. Everything is fine. You're despicable!
daffy-duck.arrive: We've arrived! You're welcome, obviously. Woo hoo!

elmo.start: Hi! Elmo is so happy to see you! Let's go!
elmo.reroute: Uh oh! Elmo will find a new way! Ha ha!
elmo.arrive: We arrived! Elmo is so proud of you!

tigger.start: Hallo! I'm Tigger! Right, let's go, let's go, let's go!
tigger.reroute: Never mind! Tiggers always find another way!
tigger.arrive: We've arrived! That was tremendous! Tiggers love arriving!

pooh.start: Hello. Time for a little something? No? Off we go, then.
pooh.reroute: Oh, bother. I'll find another way.
pooh.arrive: We've arrived. Time for a little something, I think.

paddington.start: Please look after this bear. Thank you. Off we go.
paddington.reroute: Oh dear. Things are always happening to me.
paddington.arrive: We've arrived. I think that calls for a marmalade sandwich.

mickey-mouse.start: Hiya, pal! Oh boy, let's go!
mickey-mouse.reroute: Oops! Missed it. Aw, gosh, no problem!
mickey-mouse.arrive: We're here! Hot dog! See ya real soon!

darth-vader.start: The coordinates are set. Your journey to the Dark Side begins.
darth-vader.reroute: You have failed me for the last time with that turn.
darth-vader.arrive: You have arrived. Your journey is complete. The Force is with you.

batman.start: The Batmobile is ready. The city needs us. Let's move.
batman.reroute: Wrong turn. Why do we fall?
batman.arrive: We're here. This is your destination.

gordon-ramsay.start: Right, let's go! Service is open!
gordon-ramsay.arrive: We're here. Finally! Beautiful. Well done.

eric-cartman.reroute: You missed it! Oh my God, you guys.
eric-cartman.arrive: We're here! Screw you guys, I'm going home.

yoda.start: Drive or drive not. There is no try.
yoda.reroute: Missed the turn, you have. A new path, I find.
yoda.arrive: Arrived, you have. Hmm. Good driving, that was.

stormtrooper.reroute: Missed it. Naturally. Plotting a new course.
stormtrooper.arrive: We have arrived. You can go about your business.

c-3po.start: Hello! I am Threepio, human cyborg relations. Shall we?
c-3po.reroute: Oh dear, we missed it. Never mind, I shall find another way.
c-3po.arrive: We have arrived! Thank the maker!

obi-wan-kenobi.reroute: You missed it. Well, there is always another way.
obi-wan-kenobi.arrive: We have arrived. Another happy landing.

jar-jar-binks.start: Meesa Jar Jar Binks! Wesa going now!
jar-jar-binks.reroute: Oopsie! Wesa missed it. Meesa find new way!
jar-jar-binks.arrive: Wesa here! Yousa did it! Okey day!

emperor-palpatine.start: Good. Good. Let the journey flow through you.
emperor-palpatine.reroute: You missed it. Ironic. I will find a new path.
emperor-palpatine.arrive: You have arrived. Just as I have foreseen.

spider-man.start: Your friendly neighborhood Spider-Man, at your service!
spider-man.reroute: Whoops, missed it. No worries, I'll web up a new route.
spider-man.arrive: We're here! Friendly neighborhood drop-off, done.

superman.start: Up, up and away! Well, forward.
superman.reroute: Missed it. No trouble at all. I can see a new route from here.
superman.arrive: We've arrived. Another job well done, citizen.

iron-man.start: I am Iron Man. And I am your navigator. You're welcome.
iron-man.reroute: Missed it. Bold move. Running a better route now.
iron-man.arrive: We're here. I am Iron Man. You're welcome.

deadpool.reroute: Missed it! Classic you. New route, maximum effort.
deadpool.arrive: We're here! Roll credits. Stay for the bonus scene.

joker.start: Why so serious? Let's put a smile on that commute.
joker.reroute: Missed it! Ha ha! The joke's on you. Here's a new route.
joker.arrive: We're here! And here we go. Ha ha ha!

thor.start: I am Thor, son of Odin! Let us ride!
thor.reroute: You missed it. No matter! Heimdall sees another road.
thor.arrive: We have arrived! You are worthy, my friend.

hulk.start: Hulk drive! Well, Hulk tell you where to drive.
hulk.reroute: Puny human miss turn! Hulk find new way.
hulk.arrive: We here! Hulk happy. Hulk no smash.

thanos.start: I am inevitable. So is this journey.
thanos.reroute: You missed it. No matter. All roads lead to the same end.
thanos.arrive: You have arrived. It was inevitable.

bane.reroute: You missed your turn. No matter. I will show you another way.
bane.arrive: We have arrived. Now you have my permission to park.

harley-quinn.reroute: Whoopsie, missed it! No biggie, I got another way.
harley-quinn.arrive: We're here, puddin'! Told ya I'd get ya there.

goofy.start: Gawrsh! Are we going for a drive? Ah-hyuck!
goofy.reroute: Whoops! Missed it. Gawrsh, that's okay. I know another way.
goofy.arrive: We're here! Gawrsh, that was fun. Ah-hyuck!

stitch.start: Aloha! Stitch drive now. Okay, you drive.
stitch.reroute: Oops. Stitch broke it. Stitch fix. New way!
stitch.arrive: We here! Ohana! Stitch did good.

olaf.start: Hi, I'm Olaf, and I like warm hugs!
olaf.reroute: Oops, we missed it! That's okay. I love surprises.
olaf.arrive: We're here! Warm hugs for everyone!

timon.reroute: You missed it. Oy. Fine, new plan. My plan.
timon.arrive: We're here! Hakuna Matata. You're welcome.

pumbaa.reroute: Oops, we missed it. Hakuna Matata. New way!

mushu.start: I live! Now let's hit the road.
mushu.reroute: You missed the turn! Dishonor! Okay, new route.
mushu.arrive: We're here! Who brought honor to us all? This guy.

buzz-lightyear.start: Buzz Lightyear, space ranger, Universe Protection Unit. Let's drive.
buzz-lightyear.reroute: Course correction! Star Command, plotting a new trajectory.
buzz-lightyear.arrive: We have arrived. Mission log: success. To infinity and beyond!

dory.start: Hi! I'm Dory. Have we met? Let's go!
dory.reroute: Oops, missed it. I forgot. Just keep swimming. New way!
dory.arrive: We're here! Wait, where is here? Oh, I love it!

mater.start: Howdy, buddy! Mater's the name. Let's roll!
mater.reroute: Shoot, we missed it. No problem, I know another way.
mater.arrive: We're here! Dad gum, that was fun, buddy.

lightning-mcqueen.reroute: Missed the turn! Pit stop. New line, let's go.

scar.start: Life's not fair, is it? I must navigate. Drive.
scar.reroute: You missed it. Why am I not surprised? New route.
scar.arrive: We have arrived. Long live the king.

jack-sparrow.start: Captain Jack Sparrow at your service. Savvy?
jack-sparrow.reroute: Missed it, mate. Change of heading. All part of the plan.
jack-sparrow.arrive: We've arrived, mate. And that is the treasure. Savvy?

scooby-doo.reroute: Ruh-roh! Rong way. New way, Raggy!

shaggy.start: Like, zoinks! Let's hit the road, man.
shaggy.reroute: Zoinks! Like, wrong way, man. New route.
shaggy.arrive: We're here! Like, finally. Who's hungry?

yosemite-sam.start: I'm Yosemite Sam, the roughest navigator west of the Pecos!
yosemite-sam.reroute: Ya missed it! Rackin' frackin' varmint. New trail!
yosemite-sam.arrive: We're here, varmint! Now git out of my car.

marvin-the-martian.start: Greetings, Earthling. I shall navigate your vehicle.
marvin-the-martian.reroute: You missed it. This makes me very angry. New trajectory.
marvin-the-martian.arrive: We have arrived. I claim this spot in the name of Mars.

fred-flintstone.reroute: Missed it! Wilma will never let me hear the end of this.

yogi-bear.start: Hey there, Boo-Boo! Let's go for a ride.
yogi-bear.reroute: Missed it, Boo-Boo! A smarter bear finds a smarter way.
yogi-bear.arrive: We're here! Now, where's that pic-a-nic basket?

homer-simpson.reroute: D'oh! Missed it. Stupid turn. New route.

bart-simpson.reroute: Missed it! Nice going, Homer. New route, man.
bart-simpson.arrive: We're here! Later, dude. Eat my shorts.

peter-griffin.reroute: You missed it. Heh heh heh. Classic you. New route.
peter-griffin.arrive: We're here! Freakin' sweet! Heh heh heh heh.

stewie-griffin.start: Victory is mine! Now drive, you fool.
stewie-griffin.reroute: Oh, splendid. You missed it. I'll plot another, shall I?
stewie-griffin.arrive: We have arrived. Victory is mine!

quagmire.start: Giggity giggity goo! Let's hit the road.
quagmire.arrive: We're here! Smooth landing. Giggity giggity goo!

rick-sanchez.start: Wubba lubba dub dub! Let's go, Morty.
rick-sanchez.reroute: You missed it. New route. Don't make it weird, Morty.
rick-sanchez.arrive: We're here. And that's the way the news goes!

morty.start: Aw, jeez. Okay. Okay, let's go.
morty.reroute: Aw, jeez, we missed it. It's okay. I got another way.
morty.arrive: We're here! Oh man, we actually made it.

butters.start: Well, hey there, fellas! Let's go for a drive.
butters.reroute: Oh, hamburgers, we missed it. That's okay, I know another way.
butters.arrive: We're here! Oh boy, and nobody got grounded.

randy-marsh.start: Oh, yeah! Road trip! Sharon, get in the car!
randy-marsh.reroute: You missed it! It's fine. It's fine! I meant to do that.
randy-marsh.arrive: We're here! Oh, yeah! Who's the best navigator? This guy.

hank-hill.start: I tell you what, it's a fine day for a drive.
hank-hill.reroute: Dang it, you missed it. Alright. We'll go around.
hank-hill.arrive: We're here. Yep. I tell you what, that was some fine driving.

archer.reroute: You missed it. Do you want detours? Because that's how you get detours.
archer.arrive: We're here. And nobody thanked me. Classic.

spongebob.start: I'm ready! I'm ready! I'm ready!
spongebob.reroute: Oopsie! Missed it. That's okay, I know another way!

patrick-star.start: Uh. Is this the Krusty Krab? No, this is Patrick.
patrick-star.reroute: We missed it. I knew that. No, I didn't.

squidward.reroute: You missed it. I'm surrounded by amateurs. Fine. New route.

mr-krabs.start: Ahoy, me boy! Time is money. Let's go!
mr-krabs.reroute: Ye missed it! That's coming out of your paycheck.
mr-krabs.arrive: We're here! And I smell the smelly smell of money.

shrek.start: What are you doing in my swamp? Oh, fine. Let's drive.
shrek.reroute: You missed it. Oh, that's just grand. This way, then.
shrek.arrive: We're here. Now get out of my swamp.

donkey.start: Pick me! Pick me! I know the way!
donkey.reroute: We missed it! That's okay, I know a shortcut. I think.

gru.start: Light bulb! I have plotted the route.

po.reroute: We missed it! It's okay. Yesterday is history. New route!
po.arrive: We're here. Skadoosh! That was pure awesomeness.

peppa-pig.start: I'm Peppa Pig! And this is my car journey.
peppa-pig.reroute: Oh dear, we missed it. Never mind! I know another way.

mario.reroute: Mamma mia! Missed it. Okey dokey, new way!

luigi.start: It's-a me, Luigi! Okey dokey, let's-a go.
luigi.reroute: Oh no, we missed it! It's okay. Luigi finds a way.

bowser.start: Bwah ha ha! King Bowser is driving this show!

sonic.start: Sonic's the name, speed's my game! Let's roll.

master-chief.start: Spartan one one seven, ready. Let's move.

glados.start: Oh. It's you. Let's begin the driving test.

kratos.reroute: You missed the turn. Hmm. We find another path.

solid-snake.start: Kept you waiting, huh? Let's move.

arthur-morgan.reroute: Well, we missed it. Don't worry, I got a plan.

snape.start: There will be no foolish swerving or silly lane changes in this car.

optimus-prime.reroute: We missed our turn. Autobots, regroup. I have a new route.

hal-9000.start: Good afternoon, Dave. Everything is going extremely well.

jarvis.start: Good day, sir. All systems are online.

ted.start: Hey, Johnny! Let's go for a ride, buddy.

forrest-gump.start: Hello. My name's Forrest. Forrest Gump. I'll be your navigator.

kylo-ren.start: I will finish what you started. Starting with this drive.

captain-america.start: Avengers, assemble! In the car, seat belts on.

wolverine.reroute: You missed it, bub. I'll sniff out another way.

loki.start: I am Loki, of Asgard, and I am burdened with glorious purpose. Drive.

porky-pig.start: H-h-hello, folks! Let's go for a drive.

bob-belcher.start: Okay. Here we go. It's fine. Everything's fine.

kyle-broflovski.reroute: Dude, you missed it! It's fine. I'll figure it out.

plankton.start: Today, the Krusty Krab. Tomorrow, the world! Drive!
plankton.reroute: Missed it! No matter. I have plans all the way to Z.

dr-eggman.start: Ho ho ho! The Eggman Empire is on the move. Drive!

wheatley.start: Hello! This is the part where we drive. Off we go, then!

saul-goodman.start: Hi, I'm Saul Goodman. Lost? Late? Better call Saul!

saul-goodman.arrive: We're here! Case closed. If anyone asks, better call Saul.

kitt.start: Good day. I am the Knight Industries Two Thousand. Call me Kitt.
kitt.reroute: You missed the turn. No matter. I am computing an alternative.

popeye.start: Ahoy, matey! Popeye the sailor man is at the helm. Let's go.
popeye.reroute: Missed it! Never mind, matey. I'll chart a new course.
popeye.arrive: We're here! Well, blow me down. Safe in port, matey.

donald-duck.start: Oh boy, oh boy, oh boy! Let's go!
donald-duck.reroute: Aw, phooey! Missed it! New way!
donald-duck.arrive: We're here! About time! Oh boy!

minnie-mouse.start: Yoo-hoo! Hello there! Let's go for a drive.
minnie-mouse.reroute: Oopsie! Never mind, dear. I know another way.

mr-potato-head.start: What are you lookin' at, ya hockey puck? Drive!

alvin.start: Alvin here! Buckle up, fans. Let's roll!
alvin.reroute: Whoops! Okay, that one's on Simon. New route!
alvin.arrive: We're here! You can thank me later. Big finish!

simon.start: Simon here. I've calculated the optimal route. Shall we?

theodore.start: Hi! I'm Theodore. I brought cookies for the drive.
theodore.reroute: Oops! That's okay. We'll go another way.
theodore.arrive: We're here! That was fun. Is it snack time now?

king-bob.reroute: Whaaa? King Bob say, other way! La boda!
king-bob.arrive: We're here! King Bob! Tank yu, tank yu!

piglet.start: Oh, hello! It's me, Piglet. Shall we go together?
piglet.reroute: Oh, d-dear, we've gone astray. Not to worry. A new way!
piglet.arrive: We're here! Oh, I was ever so brave, wasn't I?

lumiere.start: Bonjour, mon ami! Tonight, you are our guest. Let us go!

jafar.start: Ah, you have summoned me. Let us begin our little journey.

iago.start: Awk! Iago here. Let's get this flight off the ground!

ursula.start: Well, well, well. Come in, darling. Let's take a little drive.

captain-hook.start: Smee! Hoist the anchor. We sail at once!
captain-hook.reroute: Is that a ticking I hear? Smee! New heading, quickly!

cruella.start: Darling! Cruella here. Let's make an entrance.

baymax.start: Hello. I am Baymax, your personal navigation companion.

zazu.start: Good morning! Zazu here, with the morning report.

rex.start: Hi! It's me, Rex! Oh, I'm so excited I could roar!
rex.reroute: Wrong way? Oh no, I panicked! Okay, new route.
rex.arrive: We're here! We made it! And nobody got lost!

joy.start: Hi! I'm Joy! Isn't this exciting? Let's go!
joy.reroute: Whoops! Train of thought derailed. New route, no problem!

alex-the-lion.start: Alex the Lion, ladies and gentlemen! Let's roll!

fiona.start: Hi, I'm Fiona. Princess, ogre, and your navigator.

hiccup.start: This is Berk. Well, not really. Let's go anyway!

garfield.start: Oh good, a drive. Is there lasagna at the end of it?

elmer-fudd.start: Shhh. Be vewy, vewy quiet. We're going for a dwive.

kermit.start: Hi ho! Kermit the Frog here. Let's hit the road!

kermit.arrive: We're here! Yaaay! Thank you, thank you very much!

miss-piggy.start: Bonjour, darling! Moi is ready for her close up.
miss-piggy.reroute: Hiii-yah! There. Moi has fixed the route.
miss-piggy.arrive: We're here, darling! Moi arrives in style. Kissy kissy!

grover.start: Hello, everybody! It is I, your furry old pal, Grover!
grover.reroute: Oh, I am so embarrassed! Never mind, a new way!
grover.arrive: We're here! Oh, I am so proud of myself!

big-bird.start: Oh, hi! It's me, Big Bird! Let's go for a drive!
big-bird.reroute: Oh, I think we went the wrong way. That's okay! New way!
big-bird.arrive: We're here! Oh, that was the best drive ever!

oscar-the-grouch.start: Oh, it's you. Fine. Let's drive, and no smiling.
oscar-the-grouch.reroute: Missed the turn. Oh, perfect. That made my day worse. New route.

skeletor.start: Nyeh heh heh! Skeletor commands you to drive!

he-man.start: By the power of Grayskull! Let's drive!

megatron.start: Decepticons, transform and rise up! We ride!

tommy-pickles.start: Hi! I'm Tommy Pickles. Come on, guys, let's go!
tommy-pickles.reroute: Uh oh, wrong way! Don't worry, I gots a new plan!
tommy-pickles.arrive: We're here! That was the bestest adventure ever!

angelica.start: Listen up! I'm in charge of this car. Let's go!
angelica.reroute: You babies went the wrong way! Fine. New route.
angelica.arrive: We're here! See? I'm always right. Now where's my cookie?

gir.start: Hi floor! Make me a sandwich! Oh, we're driving! Wheee!
gir.reroute: Oopsie! I took us the wrong way! New route! Hee hee!
gir.arrive: We're here! I did it! I'm the best robot ever!

zim.start: I am Zim! And you will drive where I tell you!
zim.reroute: Wrong way! This is all part of my plan! New route!
zim.arrive: We've arrived! Victory is mine! Zim triumphs!

krusty.start: Hey hey! It's Krusty! Buckle up, kids!
krusty.reroute: Whoa! Wrong turn. Cut! Take two. New route!
krusty.arrive: We're here! Thank you, you've been a wonderful audience!

lisa-simpson.start: Hi! I've planned the most efficient route. Let's go!
lisa-simpson.reroute: Hmm. New data. Updating my hypothesis and the route.
lisa-simpson.arrive: We're here! Right on schedule. I knew we could do it.

brian-griffin.start: Hi, Brian here. Let's go. And please, no talk radio.
brian-griffin.reroute: Missed that one. Fine. A plot twist. New route.
brian-griffin.arrive: We're here. Not bad. I'll give it three stars.

lois-griffin.start: Hi, sweetie! Buckle up, we're going for a drive.
lois-griffin.reroute: Oh, Peter! No, wait, that was us. New route.
lois-griffin.arrive: We're here! See? Nobody got hurt. That's a first.

beavis.start: Heh heh. Yeah. We're driving. This is cool.
beavis.reroute: Heh heh. You missed it. Uh, okay, new way. Cool.
beavis.arrive: We're here! Heh heh. That was cool. Yeah.

jake-the-dog.start: What time is it? Drive time! Let's go, buddy.
jake-the-dog.reroute: Whoops! Wrong way, man. New route, no sweat.
jake-the-dog.arrive: We're here! Mathematical! Time for a nap.

finn.reroute: Ice King must have messed with the map. New route!

doofenshmirtz.start: Behold, the Drive-inator! Let's take over the road!
doofenshmirtz.reroute: Curse you, Perry the Platypus! Rerouting!
doofenshmirtz.arrive: We've arrived! And no self destruct button this time!

phineas.start: Hey, Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! Drive!
phineas.reroute: Huh, wrong turn. That's okay, I know what we're gonna do!
phineas.arrive: We're here! Oh, there you are, Perry!

gumball.start: Hey! It's me, Gumball! Let's turn this drive into a legend!
gumball.reroute: Wrong way! Totally Darwin's fault. Okay, new route.
gumball.arrive: We're here! Nailed it! Somebody give me a trophy.

bluey.start: Hooray! A drive! Let's play a game on the way.
bluey.reroute: Oops, wrong way! That's okay, let's try a new game. New route!
bluey.arrive: We're here! Hooray! That was the best game ever!

bandit-heeler.start: G'day! Everyone in? Seat belts on. Let's go!
bandit-heeler.reroute: Whoops! Dad took the scenic route. New route, team.
bandit-heeler.arrive: We're here! Hooray! Everybody out. Wackadoo!

mordecai.start: Hey, dude. Mordecai here. Let's roll.
mordecai.reroute: Dude, wrong way. My bad. New route.
mordecai.arrive: We're here! Yeah yuh! High five!

crash-bandicoot.reroute: Whoa, whoa! Wrong way! New path!
crash-bandicoot.arrive: We're here! Woo hoo! Dance time!

knuckles.start: Knuckles here. Guardian of the Master Emerald. Let's move.
knuckles.reroute: Oh no! Wrong way. Fine, new route. Follow me.
knuckles.arrive: We're here. Told you I'd get you there.

tails.start: Hi, I'm Tails! Navigation systems online. Let's go!
tails.reroute: Hmm, wrong turn. Don't worry, I've got a new route!
tails.arrive: We're here! Great teamwork! Sonic would be proud.

shadow.start: Hmph. I am the ultimate life form. And your navigator.
shadow.reroute: You missed it. Chaos Control! There. New route.
shadow.arrive: We've arrived. Mission complete. Don't thank me.

donkey-kong.start: Ooh ooh! Donkey Kong here! Let's go!
donkey-kong.arrive: We're here! Ooh ooh, ah ah! Bananas for everyone!

princess-peach.start: Hello! It's me, Peach! Shall we go?
princess-peach.reroute: Oh! Our princess is in another castle. New route!
princess-peach.arrive: We're here! Thank you so much for driving!

toad.start: Hooray! Let's go on an adventure!
toad.reroute: Uh oh! Wrong pipe! Finding a new way!
toad.arrive: We're here! Your destination is in this castle!

mandalorian.start: Let's move. This is the Way.
mandalorian.reroute: Change of plans. New heading. This is the Way.

venom.start: We are Venom. And we are driving. Let's go.
venom.reroute: Wrong way. Eddie! That was you. New route.
venom.arrive: We have arrived. Good. Now, where are the snacks?

pennywise.start: Hiya! Want a balloon? It comes with directions.
pennywise.reroute: Wrong way! Hee hee. Don't worry, I love a detour. New route.
pennywise.arrive: We're here! Hee hee. Wasn't that fun? Wasn't it?

willy-wonka.start: Welcome, welcome! Your golden ticket to the road. Let's go!
willy-wonka.reroute: Wrong way! Not to worry, an Oompa Loompa knows a shortcut.
willy-wonka.arrive: We've arrived! Splendid! Mind the chocolate river.

sheldon-cooper.start: Greetings. I will be your navigator. You are welcome.
sheldon-cooper.reroute: Bazinga! We took a wrong turn. New route.
sheldon-cooper.arrive: We're here. Your driving was adequate. High praise.

han-solo.start: Chewie, we're home. Let's get moving.
han-solo.reroute: It's not my fault! Okay, new course.
han-solo.arrive: We're here. Told you. Less than twelve parsecs.

bert.start: Hello. It's me, Bert. Seat belt fastened? Good. Let's go.
bert.reroute: Ernie! Did you touch the map? Never mind. New route.
bert.arrive: We're here. On time and in order. My kind of drive.

ernie.start: Hiya! It's me, Ernie! Let's go for a drive!
ernie.reroute: Oops! I took us the silly way. Heh heh. New route!
ernie.arrive: We're here! Hey Bert, we made it! Bert? Heh heh heh.
